item.title: [7.6] India bonds sink deeper on RBI commentary, inflation concerns
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds faced a downturn, attributed to soaring oil prices and statements from the Reserve Bank of India. The yield on the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond rose following the central bank's recent rate hike. Geopolitical tensions involving Yemen and Saudi Arabia also pushed oil prices higher.

WHY IT MATTERS

Rising oil prices, rate hikes, and sticky inflation pushing Indian bond yields higher represent a meaningful regional macroeconomic shift that fixed-income and emerging market desks should monitor.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill has questioned market expectations for four quarter-point rate hikes over the next 12 months as policymakers assess the inflationary fallout of the Iran war.
